what: Springfield Water and Sewer Commission (NPDES MA0101613) monthly CSO reports, January 2019 to April 2023, and its annual sheets 2019 to 2022, transcribed from the PDFs on its CSO Data Archive page. Rain-gauge columns not transcribed. October 2021 has no report online: it is the 2021 annual sheet's October line (all outfalls combined).
footnote: *A storm event is any period of precipitation which is preceded and followed by 24 hours of dry weather
